policy: Standing campaign policy, unchanged: one slot per board per day, best two submissions across the competition, an unused slot cannot be banked.

agi2.what: v11 identical resubmit #5 (kernel version 11, no new run)
agi2.decision_dependency: weak-positive, not a measurement. Selection is best-of-draws over the selected pair, so this slot pays only if the draw beats 30.97 (1 of the 4 observed draws did: 28.89, 29.31, 30.56, 30.97). Expected value is non-negative and the slot cannot be recovered, so it is spent.

predeclared.>= 30.97: new best draw; it becomes the leading final submission and the selection pair is rewritten around it.
predeclared.< 30.97: no change to the selection; record the draw and move on. Not evidence about the method (n=1, byte-identical code).

agi3.honest_value_note: ARC-AGI-3 rank prizes remain out of reach (board top ~7.5), so this slot buys selection optionality and writeup material only. It is fired because the slot cannot be banked and the flow is automated, not because a rank-dependent decision depends on it. It was still worth firing: the draw moved the project best 0.21 -> 0.26.
